title: Celebration Card
method: Native SVG invitation: arched card and ribbon, balloons and decorative strokes, then original JOIN US lettering and date paths.
limitations: A fictional invitation with a demonstration date. All lettering is original monoline path geometry, not an external typeface.

notes: Portrait proportions, arched paper, balloons, ribbon and original JOIN US and 08.24 path lettering are preserved. The complete date sits inside the ribbon. Source and final comparison panels are pixel-identical; no external font is used.

Inspected actual offline Chromium source/drawing/final preview plus opening/middle/final on light, dark and checkerboard backgrounds. Opening is blank without added blue decoration; exterior transparency and source-colored interior areas are preserved.
Inspected decoded GIF opening, drawing and final frames: 480x608, 41 stored frames, 4800 ms including final hold. The declared #F6EDF0 GIF matte is opaque, while HTML and PNG retain exterior alpha.
Original outline colors are retained. Dark source outlines have lower contrast on dark test surfaces; the supplied light matte provides the intended presentation contrast.
